newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks end sharply higher for second day.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks end sharply higher for second day.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended sharply higher for a second day Thursday as strength in bonds extended the market's bounce from five-straight sessions of losses.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 83.12 points at 6,823.86, adding to Wednesday's gain of 85 points. In the broader market, advancing issues beat declines 15-9 on heavy volume of 523 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
